title: Department of State Memoranda from American Embassy Tunis: Tunisian Firefall, July 14, 1969
doc_notes: This document is a Department of State cable from the American Embassy in Tunis reporting on a fireball phenomenon observed on July 13, 1969.

incidents.summary: Observation of two greenish-blue circular phenomena near the Polar Star by multiple observers including embassy officials.
incidents.quote: PHENOMENA ALMOST IDENTICAL THAT OF REFTEL SEEN BY MANY OBSERVERS TUNIS EVENING JULY 13 INCLUDING EMBASSY OFFICIALS.
